title: Local web dashboard over the tutor's data, with the acquisition actions it can honestly drive
authority_required: operator instruction, 2026-09-12: a local dashboard showing owned items, completed missions, goals, prerequisites and everything else the backend holds; decision protocol answers: stdlib `serve` + buildless page, full control including inventory fetch
scope: `kad-warframe serve`: a stdlib http.server dashboard bound to 127.0.0.1, no third-party dependency and no build step
listing surfaces the CLI was missing: `items` (owned equipment, blueprints, resources, mods, unresolved refs) and `missions` (completed nodes resolved through WFCD Node.json), both with --json
a JSON API whose payloads come from the same functions the CLI calls, so no advice is reimplemented in the web layer
a buildless single-page frontend served from the package: overview, goals with their evidence, items, missions, quests and prerequisites, freshness, needs-attention

actions: refresh the WFCD datasets in-process, and drive warframe-helper's own TUI in a tmux session for the inventory fetch and the database sync, with the screen captured and every step verified before any key is sent
invariants carried into the UI: freshness visible and advising blocked when stale, UNKNOWN rendered as UNKNOWN, provenance and confidence on curated advice, platinum-0 discipline
non_scope: reimplementing the memory scan or the mobile-API inventory fetch: that stays warframe-helper's code, which the dashboard drives rather than replaces
any binding other than 127.0.0.1, any authentication scheme, any CORS surface, any external CDN or font in the page
a JavaScript build step, a framework, or a second test stack
writing the player's account data anywhere new: inventory, catalog and notes stay in ~/.warframe-helper
driving a TUI step whose target screen has not been verified in the same run: the driver fails closed instead of pressing keys blind
validation: bin/kad-warframe serve --port 0 --once (serves one request and exits)
acceptance_criteria: `bin/kad-warframe serve` starts on 127.0.0.1, serves the dashboard, and exits non-zero if the port is taken
every panel the operator asked for renders real data from this account: owned items, completed missions, goals with evidence, prerequisites, quests, freshness
the JSON API returns the same values as the CLI for the same inputs (asserted in tests against one fixture state)

actions are guarded: the inventory fetch refuses without a running game process, without recorded consent, and without the helper binary; every TUI navigation step is verified against the captured screen before a key is sent
no third-party dependency is added, and the page loads with no network access at all
the suite stays hermetic: no account data, no network, no real helper process
browser verification records each panel rendering real values
evidence records the commands, the screenshots' claims and the guards' failure modes
notes: WP-KAD-WARFRAME-001 is in REVIEW and covers the tutor itself; this workpackage covers the web layer, which 001's non-scope excludes.
